evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` to ensure write failures don't cause `std::terminate` in the destructor.
rationale: Fixes an unhandled exception hazard in stream destructors that terminates the process on disk write failures. The PR resolves an issue where `BufferedWriter`'s destructor could invoke `std::terminate` on failed writes (e.g. out-of-disk space) rather than allowing callers to handle errors and shut down gracefully.
